description: This file contains utility functions for typeahead.js, a JavaScript library for building typeahead/autocomplete features. It defines various helper methods such as type checks, string manipulation, function binding, collection iteration, and other general utility functions.

methods.name: isMsie
methods.description: Detects if the browser is Internet Explorer or using Trident engine based on the user agent string.
